facts.fact: Sierra Leone's Cabinet approved the National Data Protection Policy and a new Data Protection and Right to Access Information Act, with the report saying the reform builds on years of consultations involving civil society groups, the media, security institutions and development partners; no consultation date is given, so the document's publication date is used.
